chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Fuḍayl, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام.
That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform thirteen rakʿahs after the night had reached its midpoint.

key_terms.اللَّيْلُ: the night, referring here to the time period for night prayer

ai.seo_question: When did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the night nawafil, and how many rakʿahs did he pray?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform thirteen rakʿahs after the middle of the night. It is cited in the context of the beginning time for the nawafil of the night and indicates the Prophetic sunnah regarding night prayer.
